Put a control in the plot's Style sheet

Source: R/panel-builder.R
scroll_style_input.Rd

Decorates a scroll_input_*() spec so the builder renders it in the panel's Style sheet (opened from the paintbrush button in the plot toolbar) instead of the control column. Use it for "how the plot looks" options – palettes, point sizes, aspect ratio – and keep "what to plot" in the column. The control keeps its id, so the plot function reads it from input exactly as before, and it can be combined with scroll_show_when().

Usage

scroll_style_input(control_spec)

Arguments

control_spec

A control spec from a scroll_input_*() constructor.

Value

The decorated control spec.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
register_plot_panel("my_panel",
  controls = list(
    scroll_input_column("group", "Group by", type = "categorical"),
    scroll_style_input(scroll_input_slider("size", "Point size", 0.1, 3, 1, 0.1))),
  plot = function(cells, input, data) ...)
} # }
